functional-dependency.title: Functional Dependency
functional-dependency.last_question: What is the difference between partial and transitive dependency?
functional-dependency.last_answer: A partial dependency is a non-key attribute depending on part of a composite key; a transitive dependency is a non-key attribute depending on another non-key attribute.

java-introduction-5-pages:java-practices.last_question: What is one important good programming practice regarding comments?
java-introduction-5-pages:java-practices.last_answer: Use comments to explain why a decision was made, not merely to repeat what the code does.

java_intro:T1.last_question: What are two main advantages of Java's design compared to C/C++?
java_intro:T1.last_answer: Automatic memory management (garbage collection) and avoidance of some low-level operations.

java_intro:T2.last_question: Describe the typical workflow for developing and running a Java program using the JDK and JVM.

java_intro:T3.title: Java Basics: Variables, Operators & Control Flow
java_intro:T3.last_question: What is the primary difference between a while loop and a do-while loop?
java_intro:T3.last_answer: A 'do-while' loop executes its body at least once, whereas a 'while' loop may not execute at all if the condition is initially false.

java_intro:T4.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in Java
java_intro:T4.last_question: What is the main difference between a method and a constructor?
java_intro:T4.last_answer: A method performs a task and may return a value, while a constructor initializes a new object and has no return type.

java_intro:T5.title: Advanced Java Concepts & Best Practices
java_intro:T5.last_question: Name two good programming practices mentioned in the lecture.
java_intro:T5.last_answer: Choose meaningful names, indent code consistently, use comments to explain 'why', validate input, prefer clear solutions, test thoroughly, use version control. (Any two of these)
